name: SHS Launch Signoff and ClientOps Activation Gate V1
goal: Formalize the exact checklist required before a project can be considered launched.

required: Forms/interactions pass or are explicitly out of scope
qa_signoff.current_evidence: Phase 5 runbook defines criteria; SHF-Next QA and validateQAToClientOps require QA record, 100% score, and no critical blockers for ClientOps conversion.

required: Operator confirms all runbook phases completed or exception-approved
Operator confirms build packet, QA evidence, reports, route smoke, leakage audit, and launch constraints
Operator confirms no private SHS data moves to public SHF surfaces
Operator records owner, timestamp, notes, and exceptions
operator_signoff.current_evidence: Runbooks require delivery owner/operator signoff; no hard operator signoff field or approval ledger was found.

required: Build packet and QA records attached
delivery_signoff.current_evidence: SHF-Next QA checklist includes build packet attached, handoff guide prepared, support tier attached, and delivery readiness calculation.

launch_signoff.current_evidence: Phase 6 runbook defines fields; no dedicated SHRV1 launch gate route or hard runtime gate was found.

required: Maintenance, support, health, routes, reports, and monthly review context exist
clientops_activation.current_evidence: SHF-Next ClientOps conversion filters delivery-ready projects, calls validateQAToClientOps, and creates ClientOps records with launch date, support tier, routes, reports, maintenance, tickets, health, version history, upgrades, and monthly review status.

launch_checklist: Confirm Phase 4 Build Packet is approved or exception-approved
Confirm QA score is 100% for ClientOps conversion
Confirm no critical QA blockers remain
Confirm desktop, mobile, navigation, forms, permissions, reports, leakage, screenshot QA, and functional QA pass
Confirm build and governance checks pass
Confirm operator signoff owner, timestamp, and notes
Confirm final approval status and approval owner
Confirm client signoff status, signer, and date
Confirm launch date, launch window, and launch owner
Confirm active modules, routes, reports, package, and support tier
Confirm handoff notes and known exceptions
Confirm rollback plan and rollback owner
Confirm no public claims bypass Truth Spine/report readiness/public approval
clientops_activation_checklist: Confirm no critical QA blockers remain
Confirm launch date and renewal date
Confirm active modules, routes, and reports
Confirm version history includes V1 launch baseline
Assign ClientOps owner or support owner
currently_exists: QA runbook and launch runbook define signoff steps
SHF-Next QA has checklist, readiness score, critical blockers, handoff guide, support tier, and Delivery Ready flow
SHF-Next ClientOps exposes only delivery-ready projects that pass QA readiness
SHF-Next ClientOps conversion validates QA record, 100% QA, and no critical blockers
ClientOps record creation seeds launch date, renewal date, support tier, routes, reports, maintenance, tickets, health, version history, upgrade recommendations, and monthly review status
missing: Dedicated SHRV1 launch gate route or model
Explicit rollback checklist and rollback owner
ClientOps owner/support owner as required activation field
Production auth/session and durable persistence for paid launch
manual: Truth/report/public approval verification when reports or public claims are in scope
paid_launch_blockers: No hard SHRV1 Launch Gate route/model
ClientOps activation is local/internal rather than production durable
ClientOps owner/support owner is not hard-required in current data model
Production auth/session hardening remains outside this gate
Durable persistence remains incomplete for paid launch
Report/public claim readiness remains manually verified unless tied to Truth Spine/public approval at runtime
